basic_info.description: Uncover the potential of this charming home nestled in the heart of the Crocker Amazon neighborhood. Featuring 2 bedrooms, 1 bath, and a 1-car garage, this property offers approximately 1,216 square feet of living space on a aprx 2,509-square-foot lot. It's the perfect opportunity for seasoned investors seeking their next project or homeowners eager to create and personalize their dream home. As a fixer-upper, this home invites your vision to transform its possibilities into reality. Ideally situated in the Excelsior District, it boasts convenient access to public transportation, including the nearby Balboa Park BART Station. It's also just a short drive to City College of San Francisco and steps away from a church, Mission Street, and a variety of shopping and dining options. Whether you're planning to flip this property for profit or design a space uniquely your own, this home offers a rare chance to bring your ideas to life. Don't miss the opportunity to turn this diamond in the rough into the perfect home!
